author: diathila
quote: Ocarina of Time is ridiculously overrated. I genuinely don't see what people find so special about it beyond nostalgia. The gameplay is outdated, the pacing is awful and the whole experience feels far more boring than people make it out to be. Stop pretending this game is untouchable. Being influential decades ago doesn't automatically make it a masterpiece today.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: diathila
quote: I honestly can't put into words how much I love this game. GTA 6 is easily the best game I've ever played, and nothing else has come close to making me feel this immersed. I find myself getting lost in its world for hours, just enjoying the little details and everything it has to offer. This is the kind of game that reminds me why I love gaming in the first place. An absolute masterpiece.
